module_summary: APB slave wrapping a 1024-word byte-strobed demo memory: setup-phase PSEL decode writes or reads memory and asserts PREADY one cycle later.

anchors.name: PSEL
anchors.why: APB select qualifying setup phase for PREADY, memory write and read

anchors.name: PENABLE
anchors.why: APB access-phase strobe; setup phase detected as PSEL and not PENABLE

anchors.name: PREADY
anchors.why: Registered ready asserted one cycle after setup phase

anchors.name: PADDR
anchors.why: Word address indexing memory for writes and reads

anchors.name: PWRITE
anchors.why: Selects memory write versus PRDATA read

anchors.name: PWDATA
anchors.why: Write data bytes stored into memory

anchors.name: PWSTRB
anchors.why: Per-byte write enables for memory writes

anchors.name: PRDATA
anchors.why: Registered read data loaded from memory on read setup

anchors.name: PSLVERR
anchors.why: Slave error output tied to zero

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: 1024x32 demo memory written with strobes and read to PRDATA

groups.name: APB handshake control
groups.description: Detects APB setup phase and generates one-cycle PREADY

groups.name: Demo memory
groups.description: Byte-strobed memory array with registered read port
